# skycloak_webhook_subscription (Resource)

A webhook subscription delivering workspace events to an HTTPS endpoint. `signing_secret` and `authorization_header` are write-only: the API never returns them and reads report `has_*` booleans instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_webhook_subscription" "ops" {
  name           = "ops-alerts"
  url            = "https://hooks.example.com/skycloak"
  source         = "keycloak"
  event_types    = ["LOGIN_ERROR", "USER_DISABLED_BY_PERMANENT_LOCKOUT"]
  signing_secret = var.webhook_signing_secret # write-only; never read back

  # Optional: scope deliveries to one cluster.
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (List of String) Event types to deliver. See the `skycloak_webhook_event_types` data source for the catalog.
- `name` (String) Subscription name.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret used to sign deliveries. Write-only; never read back.
- `source` (String) Event source: `keycloak` or `platform`.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint receiving deliveries.

### Optional

- `authorization_header` (String, Sensitive) Authorization header value sent with each delivery. Write-only; omit to retain the stored value.
- `cluster_id` (String) Scope deliveries to one cluster. Omit for all clusters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are active. Defaults to `true`.
- `realm_id` (String) Scope deliveries to one Keycloak realm ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `has_authorization_header` (Boolean) Whether an authorization header is stored.
- `has_signing_secret` (Boolean) Whether a signing secret is stored.
- `id` (String) Subscription ID (UUID).
- `updated_at` (String)
